description: Represents a single worksheet within a spreadsheet workbook.

members.name: Clone
members.description: Creates a deep copy of this sheet.

members.name: EvaluateFormula
members.description: Evaluates the formula of a specific cell and stores the result in Value/DisplayValue.

members.name: GetCell
members.description: Retrieves a cell at the given row and column indices.

members.name: GetCellAndDependentRefs
members.description: Returns the given cells plus every transitive dependent cell that may need a renderer refresh after recalculation.

members.name: GetOrCreateCell
members.description: Retrieves or creates a cell at the given A1 reference.

members.name: RecalculateDependents
members.description: Recursively recalculates all cells that depend on the given cell.

members.name: SetCellFormula
members.description: Sets a cell formula at the given row and column indices, evaluates it and recalculates dependents.

members.name: SetCellValue
members.description: Sets a cell value at the given row and column indices and recalculates dependents.

members.name: UpdateDependencies
members.description: Updates the dependency graph for the given cell after its formula changes.

members.name: ActiveCellRef
members.description: The A1 reference of the currently active (selected) cell.

members.name: AutoFilter
members.description: The auto-filter applied to this sheet, or null when none is active.

members.name: Cells
members.description: All cells in the sheet keyed by A1 reference (e.g. A1, B2).

members.name: ColumnCount
members.description: The total number of columns in the sheet.

members.name: Columns
members.description: Column metadata keyed by zero-based column index.

members.name: DataValidations
members.description: Data validation rules defined on this sheet.

members.name: DefaultColumnWidth
members.description: The default column width in pixels.

members.name: DefaultRowHeight
members.description: The default row height in pixels.

members.name: FreezeColumnCount
members.description: The number of columns to freeze on the left (0 = none).

members.name: FreezeRowCount
members.description: The number of rows to freeze at the top (0 = none).

members.name: MergedCells
members.description: All merged cell ranges in this sheet.

members.name: Name
members.description: The name displayed on the sheet tab.

members.name: RowCount
members.description: The total number of rows in the sheet.

members.name: Rows
members.description: Row metadata keyed by zero-based row index.

members.name: SheetIndexInWorkbook
members.description: The zero-based index of this sheet within its workbook.

members.name: ShowGridLines
members.description: Whether grid lines are visible.

members.name: Workbook
members.description: The workbook that owns this sheet, if any.
